demonstratedFindings.finding: The3,224ms completion gap is exactly reconstructible without assigning it to provider latency.
A lower-priority enrichment was selected before pricing was due, but entered the shared pacer when its earliest legal physical start was already after that pricing eligibility.
The first enrichment also consumes the next legal start slot: starting before a pricing due time is insufficient if another1s start-spacing interval would push pricing beyond that due time.
demonstratedFindings.evidence: Admission must account for the protected next start and preparation/completion margin, not just current physical concurrency.

demonstratedFindings.finding: The subsequent pricing request waits almost another1s after the second enrichment starts.
Point-of-use quote freshness and completed evaluation cadence are separate measurements.
demonstratedFindings.evidence: The delayed evaluation still used a23ms-old validated quote; its preceding completed evaluation was3224ms earlier.

inferredButNotIsolated.finding: The end-to-end logical-to-physical interval is consistent with local minimum-start pacing as the dominant delay.
inferredButNotIsolated.reason: The exact lower bound from the preceding recorded physical invocation leaves only2ms beyond the mandatory next start for the delayed pricing call.

inferredButNotIsolated.finding: A36ms completion-to-pricing-dispatch residual is consistent with the100ms sampling loop and normalization work.
inferredButNotIsolated.reason: There are no enqueue, timer-fired or dispatcher-eligible stamps, so timer wake delay, loop phase, normalization and durability costs cannot be separated.

limitations: No new network call, scheduler run or corrected forward-capacity test was performed.
Eligibility uses recorded scheduledAt and recorded enrichmentDelayMs; hinted trades are not assumed available before their confirmed-enrichment response.

Job selection/request intent, budget reservation, physical invocation and response/body completion are distinct clocks. A trace requestedAt field must not be called a physical network start without checking its record type.
Physical invocation means the local transport/fetch call. Actual socket send, proxy queue, provider queue and server execution timestamps were not recorded.
SDK decoding, recorder work and parity have no isolated timers. The23ms source-to-use interval bounds their combined cost only.
The trace does not log rejected dispatcher admissions, every queue eligibility transition or every timer wake; no invented enqueue/dequeue timestamps are supplied.
No counterfactual exact exit price, profitability, complete flow coverage, opportunity recovery or universal endpoint capacity follows from this audit.
Original forward result remains4normalized Sells,2mapping gaps plus the byte-stop gap and0complete usable flow windows; later offline corrections do not erase it.
